init.title: Polling intervals
init.description: Configure how often the SMA inverter is queried. Shorter diagnostic intervals generate more network requests and may unnecessarily load the inverter communication interface.

data_description.scan_interval: Updates the three original production entities. Allowed range: 10–300 seconds; default: 30 seconds.
data_description.fast_diagnostic_interval: Updates AC phase power and DC string power. Allowed range: 20–600 seconds; default: 30 seconds. It cannot be shorter than the production interval.
data_description.medium_diagnostic_interval: Updates voltage, current, frequency, temperature and status values. Allowed range: 30–3600 seconds; default: 60 seconds. It cannot be shorter than the phase/DC interval.

error.invalid_diagnostic_intervals: Diagnostic intervals must be ordered from shortest to longest: production, phase/DC, then status/electrical.
